issue: Comments suggest negative offsets are supported but Django queryset slicing does not support negative start indexes and will raise AssertionError if start_offset < 0 - need to either remove/reword the comment or normalize negative offsets before slicing

OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key assumes self.key refers to a numeric field (passes value to math.floor/math.ceil) but the usage in organization_auditlogs.py passes order_by='-datetime' where value is a datetime instance, which will raise TypeError

The advanced negative-offset branch relies on queryset[start_offset:stop] with potentially negative start_offset, but Django querysets do not support negative slicing and will raise AssertionError - need to translate negative offsets into equivalent positive slices

OptimizedCursorPaginator introduces new pagination behavior including negative-offset branch but has no tests covering it, while existing paginator behaviors are tested in tests/sentry/api/test_paginator.py

The optimized pagination path for audit logs (OptimizedCursorPaginator with optimized_pagination=true query param) is unrelated to the spans buffer insertion optimization described in PR title - should be in a separate PR for clarity and easier rollback
